title: cli-flag-verify telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the cli-flag-verify advisory hook. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "cli-flag-verify". Evolves additive-only.

tool.description: Claude Code tool that triggered the hook. May be an empty string — this advisory hook resolves only the file path, not the tool name.

file.description: Path of the scanned file, relative to the consuming repo root when resolvable.

findings.description: Unknown (likely-hallucinated) CLI invocations, each `<bin> [<subcmd>...] <flag>` (public CLI identifiers, not secret). Empty array when every scanned flag verified (status ok).
